reports.title: SEAGATE TECHNOLOGY REPORTS FISCAL FIRST QUARTER 2027 FINANCIAL RESULTS

guidance.heading: Business Outlook
section: The Company is providing the following guidance for its fiscal second quarter 2027:
•Revenue of $4.8 billion, plus or minus $100 million
•Non-GAAP diluted EPS of $9.20, plus or minus $0.20
Guidance regarding non-GAAP diluted EPS excludes known pre-tax charges related to estimated share-based compensation expenses of $0.30 per share.
